title: Untranslated 2-column table headers (Component/Role, Renderer/Handles) traced to a curated i18n table gap, not a code bug
trigger: Reviewing wave-tier1b-batch2-20260911(r2)'s docx-reader.md and pdf-writer.md accepted cells: the 'DocumentReader Architecture' and 'PDF Rendering Pipeline' 2-column tables left their header row in English across fa, hi, ja, ko, nl (5/5 locales checked, 2/2 pages with this table shape), while every OTHER table on the same pages (API Reference Summary: 'Class / Method | Description') translated correctly in the same locales. Recurrence across independently-run locales on first attempt = producer-side per RB-005/RB-015's own diagnostic clause, not model variance.
root_cause: src/translation_engine/extractor/text_unit_extractor.py's _is_technical_identifier() (Strategy 2 of _is_non_translatable) matches any single word shaped like `^[A-Z][a-z0-9]{3,}...$` as a PascalCase API identifier (by design, to protect real class names like Body/Cell/Camera/Presentation). This is a genuine false positive on ordinary capitalized English nouns used as table column headers: 'Component', 'Role', 'Renderer', 'Handles' all match the identical shape. The system's own mitigation for this exact class of false positive is the curated i18n template-string table (TC-HT-I18N-004, config/i18n/template_strings/): a table hit overrides do_not_translate with a real translated value regardless of the Strategy-2 verdict. 'Class'/'Description'/'Method'/'Property'/etc. are registered there (hence those headers translate correctly everywhere); 'Component'/'Role'/'Renderer'/'Handles' were simply never added. The gap was already being surfaced by the system's own discovery-log instrumentation (TC-HT-I18N-005, data/discovery/unresolved_terms.jsonl) -- confirmed 58 prior 'Role' misses logged across cs/de/fa/hi/ja/th before this investigation, 7 for 'Component', 11 each for 'Renderer'/'Handles' -- but nothing had consumed that log to add the missing registry entries yet.
not_the_cause: Not a TM caching issue (unlike the separate 'Covers Presentation.' recurrence investigated the same day) -- these header cells never had a translated value to diverge from; they were do_not_translate=True by the Strategy-2 heuristic with no i18n override, so they simply never went to the LLM at all.

Not an em-dash or table-shape parsing bug -- ruled out by checking pdf-writer.md's own working 'API Reference Summary' table on the same page, which has multi-line descriptions too and translates fine; the discriminator is specifically whether the HEADER WORD is a registered i18n table entry, not the table's shape or cell content.

The 'whole table (including data rows) left in English' variant seen specifically on docx-reader.md's ja/ko/nl cells (vs. header-only on fa/hi and on pdf-writer.md's ja/ko/nl cells) is NOT explained by this root cause alone -- the row-value sentences don't match the PascalCase regex. This narrower, more severe sub-case remains unexplained and is called out explicitly so a future investigation doesn't assume this fix covers it.
fix_applied: Added 4 new registry entries (table.header.component, table.header.role, table.header.renderer, table.header.handles) to config/i18n/template_strings/_registry.yaml, with real reviewed translations added to ja.yaml/ko.yaml/nl.yaml (all 4 terms) and fa.yaml/hi.yaml (component+role only, the 2 terms actually evidenced for those locales). Verified via classify() smoke test that all 8 new (locale, term) pairs now resolve to VERDICT_TABLE with the expected translated value, matching the existing 'Class'->translate_via_table behavior. The remaining ~30 locales this registry covers do not yet have these 4 terms translated -- documented as 128 pending pairs in reports/agents/reference-i18n-hardening-20260725/adjudication/pending_pairs.json so the existing completeness-gap regression test (test_classification_resolver.py::test_completeness_gaps_are_all_documented_adjudication_disagreements) passes honestly rather than being silently broken or force-passed. Ran the full classification + i18n test suite (70 tests) after the change: all pass.
deliberately_not_done: Did not translate these 4 terms into the other ~30 supported locales in this session -- would require generating and self-verifying translations I have no direct evidence for, risking introducing NEW errors into the curated table that's supposed to be authoritative. Left as pending_pairs for whoever next processes the discovery log (or a future iteration of this same mission) to complete with real evidence per locale, same as the existing 47 pre-existing pending pairs this file already tracked before this change.
downstream_impact: content/docs.aspose.org/en/words/python/developer-guide/docx-reader.md (fa, hi, ja, ko, nl) and content/docs.aspose.org/en/words/python/developer-guide/pdf-writer.md (ja, ko, nl) all rejected this session under RB-015 and left OPEN/ticketed -- a future retrigger for these 5 cells should now correctly translate the 'Component'/'Role' and 'Renderer'/'Handles' headers. Any OTHER already-committed page across the portfolio using a 2-column table with an unregistered header word (not just these 4 specific terms) likely has the same latent defect; this fix only closes the 4 terms found this session, not the general class.
